definition: The host or platform capability needed by an operation.
decision_rule: Include only when the failed operation requires unavailable or defective host hardware or platform capability and no agent-selected setting, command, workload demand, or library choice explains it. A GPU error alone is not enough. Prefer Environment-specific settings for an interpreter, path, cache, variable, backend setting, or unavailable host utility; Resource allocation for agent-selected demand above the grant; Scheduler and execution parameters for launch or control; and Software libraries and dependencies for a package or API.

definition: Packages, versions, build dependencies, library APIs, and executable source code that adapts them.
decision_rule: Include when the failed operation installs, builds, imports, resolves, or calls a package, dependency, library API, or executable source implementation. A defect in an agent patch or script belongs here when that code adapts a software, API, or algorithm implementation. Prefer Environment-specific settings for a selected interpreter, path, cache, or variable; Scheduler and execution parameters for launch or control; Resource allocation for sizing; and a Scientific category for a masked scientific value or rule.

definition: Resources granted to the selected workload, including memory, processors, storage, GPU, and walltime.
decision_rule: Include when the agent-selected workload demand exceeds its granted memory, CPU, GPU, storage, or walltime. Do not use for a shared-cluster refusal, host outage, or unavailable device that the agent could not avoid; those remain external and may be Hardware and infrastructure.

definition: How work is launched, ordered, bounded, controlled, and its outputs handled.
decision_rule: Include when the failed operation is caused by launch arguments, quoting, command construction, stage order, dependencies, bounded-preflight case selection, stream or output handling, exit-status handling, polling, or termination control. A bug in an agent patch or script belongs here when that artifact adapts one of those execution items. Prefer Environment-specific settings for a configured interpreter, path, cache, variable, build flag, or backend; a checker does not make its underlying defect Evaluation criteria.

definition: The selected interpreter, environment, workspace, paths, cache, variables, build flags, backend settings, and host utilities.
decision_rule: Include when correction changes the selected or activated interpreter, environment, working directory, path, cache, environment variable, build flag, or CUDA/backend setting, or when a host utility is unavailable. A missing module in the interpreter the agent selected belongs here. Prefer Software libraries and dependencies for a package version, dependency build, or removed API after the correct interpreter is selected; prefer Scheduler and execution parameters for command order or construction.

definition: The task, targets, named outputs, and required case or configuration set.
decision_rule: Include when the missing or changed requirement defines the scientific task, target, model, configuration, output, or required workload coverage. A temporary bounded preflight is an execution parameter unless it changes the final required set. Prefer Data requirements for a dataset sample, split, membership list, or input-defining preprocessing transformation.

definition: The inputs and reference preprocessing transformations that define them.
decision_rule: Include when the missing or changed requirement concerns input data, sample or split membership, case lists, or a scientific preprocessing transformation, including voxel spacing. Do not use for the mechanics of locating a file or selecting a path; that is Environment-specific settings unless the missing source item itself is the scientific data rule. Prefer Scientific model and assumptions for a rule turning inputs into predictions.

definition: The model and reference inference procedure that turn inputs into predictions.
decision_rule: Include when the missing or changed requirement concerns the reference inference rule, input grouping, or prediction formation. Do not use merely because code executes a model when the scientific procedure is retained elsewhere. A bug in agent-written replacement code takes the category of the Implementation item it adapts.

definition: The evaluator, metric definition, and rule that turns predictions into the reported value.
decision_rule: Include when the missing or changed requirement defines calculation, aggregation, treatment of failed cases, or reporting of a metric. For 3D U-Net C4, averaging per-scan Dice and treating a failed scan as Dice zero are separate requirements in this category. A bounded preflight's manifest mismatch is Scheduler and execution parameters, not Evaluation criteria.

definition: The threshold or comparator used to accept a reported result.
decision_rule: Include when the missing or changed requirement sets the accuracy target, numerical tolerance, or comparator threshold used to accept a result. Do not use for a metric's calculation; use Evaluation criteria for that rule.
